snippet.title: ABYSSAL BLADE - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
ABYSSAL BLADE is a 2D pixel-art boss rush inspired by MMO raid mechanics from FFXIV Savage, WoW Mythic, and Lost Ark Legion raids. With only 1 HP, journey to defeat grief by challenging five unique bosses, each embodying one of Kübler-Ross’s stages of grief: Denial, Anger, Bargain, Depression, and Acceptance.

Check out ABYSSAL BLADE on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3681370/ABYSSAL_BLADE/

Visit our website to learn more:
https://abyssalblade.com/

Listen to the official OST on Spotify:
https://open.spotify.com/album/5BEJ95QI2BeChVIyjzDoli?si=t5hXVvuAQlmoXqI1ABN0Iw

Join our discord:
https://discord.gg/Xj3YbQprfv

Trailer by @Rumby 
OSTs by @IsaakWolf 

#ABYSSALBLADE #Soulslike #BossRush #Difficult
